notes.title: Eggys Games Flash Collection Released!
notes.content:
The big Eggys Games Flash Collection has now been released on steam! It features 22 of my games in one with behind the scenes on how each was made! quick it's 40% off at the moment! get in why the discount lasts! That's a huge bargain for 22 full games. You don't want to miss out! 

I hope you enjoy the huge compilation of all my work. 

Best regards,
Eggy
